description: Returns YARA/Sigma detection rules for an ICS malware family or threat actor. Rules sourced from public corpus (Florian Roth signature-base, CISA advisories) are marked validated:true and safe for staging. DeepSeek-synthesised rules carry validated:false and require lab testing. Designed for automated threat hunting pipelines that commit rules to SIEMs and EDRs. Price: $0.05 USDC per call via x402 on Base mainnet. An unpaid call returns an x402 PaymentRequired challenge; retry the identical call with the signed payload in _meta["x402/payment"].

target.description: Malware or actor name e.g. PIPEDREAM, INDUSTROYER2, TRITON, SANDWORM, CHERNOVITE

name: getDetectionArtifacts
title: ICS Detection Artifact Retrieval
